attempts.summary: Configured logrotate on node1 to rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily, retain 7 compressed rotations, and use copytruncate so the application can keep writing to the same file handle after rotation. Verified rotation, compression, and the 7-rotation retention cap via forced test cycles, then reset state. Completed the mandatory restart evidence protocol on node1: captured pre-restart baseline, issued a deferred reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed (proving a real restart), and confirmed post-restart that the logrotate config, active timer, and rotation/write behavior all recovered.
